'''Saber 2,''' which was also designated '''Saber Two''', was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] serving in the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing's]] [[Saber Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Saber Squadron]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by the 181st's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Saber 2 participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ended with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], although Phennir himself managed to survive.

==Description==
Saber 2,<ref name="CCG" /> also designated as Saber Two, was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]],<ref name="CSWE" /> manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="DB" /> Saber 2's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] featured the standard wheel and yoke control system for [[TIE pilot]]s.<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Major Turr Phennir}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Split up and head back to the surface. And see if you can get a few of those TIE fighters to follow you.''"<br />"''Copy, Gold Leader.|Green Four, Jake Farrell, acknowledges Gold Leader Lando Calrissian's order to draw off Saber 2 and other pursuing Imperial starfighters|<ref name="Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:TurrPhennirinROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Turr Phennir flying Saber 2]]
Saber 2 was assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing's]] [[Saber Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Saber Squadron]]<ref name="CSWE" /> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Saber 2 was flown by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], an [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] of the 181st.<ref name="CSWE" /> In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] occurred, during which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attacked the Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="NEC" />

Saber 2 participated in the battle, where it was responsible for Saber Squadron's logistics<ref name="CCG" /> along with protecting the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].<ref name="CSWE" /> The 181st was also tasked with protecting the ''Imperial II''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']] during the battle, although the latter [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was destroyed.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> As Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] entered the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to destroy its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]],<ref name="Jedi" /> Phennir was among the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]<ref name="CCG2" /> who pursued the Alliance starfighters within the Death Star.<ref name="Jedi" />

The Alliance's [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], ordered his fellow [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] to split off and head back to the Death Star's surface to draw away some of the pursuing Imperial starfighters.<ref name="Jedi" /> Saber 2 was one of the Imperial starfighters that pursued [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]]<ref name="Death Star II personnel">{{SW|url=news/death-star-ii-personnel-and-imperial-human-resources|text=Death Star II Personnel: An Imperial Human Resources Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and other Rebel pilots away from Calrissian, who successfully destroyed the reactor core, leading to the subsequent destruction of the Death Star itself.<ref name="Jedi" /> Phennir managed to escape the Death Star's destruction and survive the battle.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Return_of_Jedi_Death_Star_fighters.png|thumb|right|250px|Saber 2 was retconned to be one of the TIE/IN interceptors seen in ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
The Saber 2 name was introduced on a card in [[2000]]'s ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="CCG" /> simultaneously also being included on Turr Phennir's card within the same set. While Phennir's card shows an image<ref name="CCG2" /> of a TIE pilot from the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], that pilot is seen flying a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] and not a TIE/IN [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]]. Therefore, the pilot and starfighter must be separate subjects from Turr Phennir and Saber 2,<ref name="Jedi" /> as the latter was established to be an interceptor in its own card.<ref name="CCG" /> Furthermore, neither of the cards link Saber 2 to any of the TIE/IN interceptors seen in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="CCG" /><ref name="CCG2" /> The image used on the Saber 2 card is<ref name="CCG" /> similar to another TIE/IN interceptor image seen in the "Fighter Cover" card within the same set.<ref name="CCG3">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Fighter Cover}}</ref>

Saber 2 was also mentioned in Phennir's entry in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', where it was given the alternate designation of Saber Two.<ref name="CSWE" /> On [[June 5]], [[2015]], [[Tim Veekhoven]] wrote the article "[[Death Star II Personnel: An Imperial Human Resources Guide]]" for [[StarWars.com]], which [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] Saber 2 as one of the TIE/IN interceptors from ''Return of the Jedi'', although erroneously representing Phennir with an image of the TIE pilot from ''Return of the Jedi''<ref name="Death Star II personnel" /> whom the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game previously identified him as.<ref name="CCG2" /> This article treats the ''Return of the Jedi'' TIE/LN starfighter pilot used by the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game and "Death Star II Personnel: An Imperial Human Resources Guide" as [[in-universe]] depictions of Phennir flying Saber 2.
